android.desc:
Whistle is a free offline transcription app for Android. Turn voice notes, recordings, audio files and the speech in videos into text on your phone.

Every feature is included. There are no ads, accounts, subscriptions, in-app purchases or transcription credits, and no daily or monthly transcription quotas.

Private speech to text
Transcription runs on your phone without uploading audio to a cloud service. After the initial app and speech model download, recording and transcription work without Wi-Fi or mobile data.

Record, import or share
• Record interviews, meetings, lectures and voice memos in Whistle.
• Import audio or video files to transcribe their spoken audio.
• Share voice notes and recordings from other apps into Whistle.
• Record and transcribe with your screen locked to save battery.

Audio and video files
Import MP3, M4A, AAC, WAV, FLAC, Ogg, Opus and AMR audio. Transcribe speech from MP4, WebM, MKV and 3GP video files. Files must contain a readable, unprotected audio track that your phone can decode.

Transcription in 25 languages
Whistle automatically detects the spoken language and transcribes in that language.

Supports Bulgarian, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Estonian, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hungarian, Italian, Latvian, Lithuanian, Maltese, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Slovak, Slovenian, Spanish, Swedish and Ukrainian.

Keep your transcripts
Keep a transcript history, copy or save the text and share it with other apps. Longer transcriptions can continue in the background, with saved progress to help recover from interruptions.

Completely free, no ads, no in-app purchases and no accounts / network required offline voice transcription.

I have also built the macOS/Windows/Linux versions which I'll also make free to download and available on my site soon (https://blazingbanana.com/).

iOS version is built and works (extremely well), just waiting for the Apple Developer signup process to complete.

Big shout out to https://github.com/mybigday/whisper.rn and https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/tree/main for making this even possible.

Any suggestions are welcome.

quotes.text:
I was trying to find a simple app to use for offline transcription and translation on my phone, however the Play Store is absolutely chock full of ad filled ones, paid versions, in-app purchases and stuff that's just way too complicated for what I wanted.

Whistle is simple, free, no-ads, no tracking, no network permissions required application that allows your to transcribe and share the output to wherever you want. That's it, nothing else.

Big shout out to https://github.com/mybigday/whisper.rn and https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/tree/main for making this even possible.

Any suggestions are welcome.
